name: Moshimo Sena ga, Rinjinbu to Machigatte Rinkanbu ni Haitteitara!?
original_name: もしも星奈が、隣人部と間違って輪姦部に入っていたら！？
source:
A full voice, full anime ADV about Sena from Hag*nai joining a new club that is very much NOT the Good Neighbors Club. Continuous classmate g*ngbang & teacher sex, too.
 
[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ147958.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
这是一部全程配音、全动态演出的文字冒险游戏，讲述《友少》中的星奈阴差阳错加入了一个绝非“邻人部”的新社团的故事。更有接连不断的同班同学轮奸与教师凌辱情节。
